findings:
🔵 [hetero-declare-p-unset] CUT/FOLLOW-UP `REPO_IDENTITY_FIELDS` is appended to the first `declare -p` list in `dispatch_detached_run` (the one without `|| true`) but is never initialised at script top; if a detach ever precedes the first `write_manifest`, `declare -p` returns 1 for the unset name. Cheapest hardening: `REPO_IDENTITY_FIELDS=""` next to the `. lib/repo-identity.sh` source line. Excluded: the manifest is written before detach on the exercised paths and manifest-repo-identity.test.sh runs the hetero rail end to end.
🔵 [nohup-spawn-error-silent] CUT/FOLLOW-UP `startWatcherDetached` reports `started` even when the async `spawn('nohup', …)` fails (the `error` handler is a no-op), so the spec's "any spawn error → one stderr line" holds only for sync failures. Follow-up: use `spawnSync`-style preflight (`fs.accessSync` on `nohup`/`sh` via PATH) or listen for `spawn` vs `error` before returning. Excluded: nohup/sh are present on every supported host and the missing envelope surfaces it.
🔵 [paths-empty-when-cwd-mismatch] CUT/FOLLOW-UP `writePaths` keys off the startup `scope` object, so a watcher started with `--project <key>` from a cwd outside that repo writes `{}` to `runs/paths/<key>.json` even after `identity` is later inferred from rows. Follow-up: guard `writePaths` on `identity` and skip (keep previous file) when it is null. Excluded: the only production launcher (`session-mode set`) passes the repo root as cwd.
🔵 [changelog-later] CUT/FOLLOW-UP No CHANGELOG entry for the new `status runs` fields/selectors, `--watch/--stop`, manifest `repo_identity`, marker scope fields and live pointer. Excluded: the frozen P1d sequence owns CHANGELOG/INDEX/version wiring for P1 as one commit.
🔵 [autostart-default-on-for-untracked-js-tests] CUT/FOLLOW-UP Any JS test outside the two patched files that invokes `session-mode.js set` without `AUTOPILOT_RUNS_WATCH_AUTOSTART=0` will start a real detached watcher (up to 3600 s idle-exit). Follow-up: a repo-wide grep gate for `session-mode.js set` callers lacking the env, or a jest/node test setup file exporting 0. Excluded: no such caller is visible in the diff and lib.sh covers every shell suite.
